clauses.title: Sum insured
clauses.text: The Sum Insured of Rs. 5,00,000 is available on a floater basis for all insured members for the policy year.

clauses.title: Room rent limit
clauses.text: Room, boarding and nursing expenses are payable up to 1% of the Sum Insured per day. ICU expenses up to 2% of the Sum Insured per day.

clauses.title: Sub-limits
clauses.text: Cataract surgery is payable up to Rs. 40,000 per eye per policy year.

clauses.title: Co-payment
clauses.text: Each admissible claim is subject to a co-payment of 10%, borne by the insured person.

clauses.title: Initial waiting period
clauses.text: Expenses for any illness contracted within 30 days from the first policy commencement date are excluded, except claims arising due to an accident.

clauses.title: Pre-existing diseases
clauses.text: Expenses related to pre-existing diseases declared in the proposal and accepted by the Company are excluded until 36 months of continuous coverage.

clauses.title: Specified disease waiting period
clauses.text: Expenses for the following are excluded until 24 months of continuous coverage: cataract, hernia, joint replacement including knee replacement, kidney stones, sinusitis, piles.

clauses.title: Permanent exclusions
clauses.text: Cosmetic or plastic surgery, obesity treatment, treatment outside India, and other exclusions as per IRDAI standard exclusions are not covered.

clauses.title: Non-medical items
clauses.text: Items listed in Annexure I (List of items for which coverage is not available, as per IRDAI) are not payable.

clauses.title: Claim intimation and documents
clauses.text: Intimate the Company within 24 hours of emergency hospitalisation and at least 48 hours before planned hospitalisation. Submit reimbursement documents within 30 days of discharge.
